entries.name: set_global_flag
entries.description: Defines a global flag.

extra.Notes: Flags can be appended with scopes or event targets

entries.name: clr_global_flag
entries.description: Clears a defined global flag.

entries.name: custom_tooltip
entries.description: Displays a localized key in the effect tooltip.

entries.name: log
entries.description: Displays a string in the game.log when executed.

extra.Notes: Accepts all localization commands (i.e. [Root.GetName], etc.). Does not work in scripted effects unless you use a localisation key instead of raw text as the argument.

entries.name: save_event_target_as
entries.description: Saves the current scope as a key. Is cleared once execution ends (i.e. end of event).

extra.Notes: Use event_target: to access the scope.

entries.name: save_global_event_target_as
entries.description: Saves the current scope as a key. Persists after execution until cleared via effect.

extra.Notes: Use event_target: to access the scope.

entries.name: clear_global_event_target
entries.description: Clears a specific global event target.

entries.name: clear_global_event_targets
entries.description: Clears all global event targets.

entries.name: show_ambient_object
entries.description: Displays a hidden ambient object from the map/ambient_objects.txt file.

entries.name: hide_ambient_object
entries.description: Hides a visible ambient object from the map/ambient_objects.txt file.

entries.name: enable_council
entries.description: Starts the Council of Trent.

entries.name: finish_council
entries.description: Ends the Council of Trent.

entries.name: country_event
entries.description: Fire a country event for the current country scope.

extra.Notes: You cannot fire the same event within itself with a delay of 0.

entries.name: add_country_modifier
entries.description: Adds an event modifier to the current scope as a country modifier.

extra.Notes: duration is optional, but the modifier will be removed after one day if it is not used.

entries.name: extend_country_modifier
entries.description: Extends an existing event modifier upon the current scope for the specified duration.

entries.name: remove_country_modifier
entries.description: Removes an already assigned country modifier from the current scope.

extra.Notes: Can also be used to remove ruler modifier.

entries.name: set_country_flag
entries.description: Defines a country flag for the current scope.

extra.Notes: Flags can be appended with scopes or event targets

entries.name: clr_country_flag
entries.description: Clears a defined country flag for the current scope.

entries.name: change_tag
entries.description: Changes current scope to  tag.

entries.name: switch_tag
entries.description: Switches the player view to  tag. Original country becomes controlled by AI.

entries.name: change_graphical_culture
entries.description: Changes the current scope's graphical culture. Graphical culture determines the unit models, advisor portraits, etc. that a country uses.

extra.Notes: Graphical cultures are found in {{path|common/graphicalculturetype.txt}}.

entries.name: override_country_name
entries.description: Changes the country name of current scope to .

entries.name: restore_country_name
entries.description: Restores the country name of current scope to its original.

entries.name: change_country_color
entries.description: Changes the country color of current scope to the specified color or to the color of the specified country.

extra.Notes: Either country or color must be used, but not both. Can be used with set_country_flag = has_overriden_color_flagto enable the "Restore our Color" decision.

entries.name: restore_country_color
entries.description: Restores the country color of the current scope to its original.

entries.name: add_adm_power
entries.description: Adds [[administrative power]] to the current scope.

entries.name: add_dip_power
entries.description: Adds [[diplomatic power]] to the current scope.

entries.name: add_mil_power
entries.description: Adds [[military power]] to the current scope.

entries.name: set_saved_name
entries.description: Saves a name to a unique key for usage in other effects.

extra.Notes: Usable with define_admiral, define_explorer, define_conquistador, define_general, define_ruler, define_consort, define_heir, define_advisor and spawn_rebels.

entries.name: clear_saved_name
entries.description: Clears a saved name key.

extra.Notes: Use this after using the saved name in an effect.

entries.name: change_innovativeness
entries.description: Adds [[innovativeness]] to the current scope.

entries.name: complete_mission
entries.description: Marks a mission as completed.

extra.Notes: Mission rewards are not given when using this effect. Instead, the mission is simply marked as complete. It will count towards any missions that require it, and it will count as completed in the mission_completed trigger.

entries.name: swap_non_generic_missions
entries.description: Reloads the mission tree. Useful for flag-based mission trees.

entries.name: adm_power_cost
entries.description: Scales the amount with the power cost modifier, then takes [[administrative power]] from the current scope.

entries.name: dip_power_cost
entries.description: Scales the amount with the power cost modifier, then takes [[diplomatic power]] from the current scope.

entries.name: mil_power_cost
entries.description: Scales the amount with the power cost modifier, then takes [[military power]] from the current scope.

entries.name: remove_country
entries.description: The current country scope gets removed from existence.

extra.Notes: All of the current country scope's provinces become uncolonized, all its subjects become independent, and all its units are disbanded.

entries.name: play_sound
entries.description: Plays a sound file.

extra.Notes: Sound names are found in {{path|sound/all_sounds.asset}}.

entries.name: add_years_of_income
entries.description: Adds ducats equal to the years of income defined.

extra.Notes: 1 is equal to 1 year of income, based on a country's current monthly income.

entries.name: add_treasury
entries.description: Adds ducats to the current scope.

entries.name: add_inflation
entries.description: Adds inflation to the current scope.

entries.name: add_mercantilism
entries.description: Adds mercantilism to the current scope.

entries.name: add_owned_provinces_development_ducats
entries.description: Adds money scaling with the development of the current country's provinces multiplied by multiplierand age_multiplier.

extra.Notes: triggercontrols which provinces are taken into consideration.

entries.name: add_owned_provinces_development_manpower
entries.description: Adds manpower scaling with the development of the current country's provinces multiplied by multiplierand age_multiplier.

extra.Notes: triggercontrols which provinces are taken into consideration.

entries.name: add_tariff_value
entries.description: Adds tariff value to the current scope.

extra.Notes: Tariff value is the ducats sent to an overlord by subjects such as colonial nations.

entries.name: loan_size
entries.description: Changes the loan size of the current scope.

extra.Notes:
Loan size is equal to floor(loan_size × (1/12) ×  total development) × (1 +  trade efficiency from diplomatic technology), with the default value of loan_size being 6.

Warning: This effect does not change the amount of ducats the nation gets from Debasing Currency, that value is hardcoded.

Warning: The game stores this value as a single byte, which means only values between 0 and 255 will work properly. Trying to input, say, 270, will have the game treat it as 14 (because 270 modulo 256 = 14).

entries.name: change_price
entries.description: Changes the price of a trade good globally.

entries.name: add_loan
entries.description: Takes a loan for the current scope.

entries.name: raise_war_taxes
entries.description: Raises war taxes without spending military power

entries.name: add_years_of_owned_provinces_production_income
entries.description: Grants the current scope immediate ducats based on the production income of the specified provinces over the specified duration.

entries.name: add_years_of_owned_provinces_manpower
entries.description: Grants the current scope immediate manpower based on the manpower generation of the specified provinces over the specified duration.

entries.name: add_years_of_owned_provinces_sailors
entries.description: Grants the current scope immediate sailors based on the sailor generation of the specified provinces over the specified duration.

entries.name: set_bankruptcy
entries.description: Makes the specified country go bankrupt.

entries.name: steer_trade
entries.description: The current country scope steers trade power to the specified country scope.

entries.name: add_absolutism
entries.description: Adds absolutism to the current scope.

extra.Notes: No effect if Absolutism isn't active.

entries.name: add_government_reform
entries.description:
* If {{icon|dhr}} Dharma is active, enacts a government reform, replacing any existing reform at the same tier.
* If Dharma is not active, changes to the legacy government type that this reform has listed as its legacy_equivalent.

entries.name: remove_government_reform
entries.description: * If {{icon|dhr}} Dharma is active, removes a government reform. If this reform was not in the highest achieved reform tier, the country can pick a new reform for free.

extra.Notes: No effect if Dharma isn't active.

entries.name: change_government_reform_progress
entries.description: Adds reform progress to the current scope.

entries.name: lose_reforms
entries.description: Removes government reforms from the current scope.

entries.name: add_legitimacy
entries.description: Adds legitimacy to the current scope.

extra.Notes: No effect if not a government monarchy.

entries.name: add_republican_tradition
entries.description: Adds republican tradition to the current scope.

extra.Notes: No effect if not a government using republic.

entries.name: add_scaled_republican_tradition
entries.description: Adds republican tradition to the current scope.

extra.Notes:
Scales to the government's election cycle duration.
No effect if not a government using republic.

entries.name: add_devotion
entries.description: Adds devotion to the current scope.

extra.Notes: No effect if not a government using has_devotion.

entries.name: add_horde_unity
entries.description: Adds horde unity to the current scope.

extra.Notes: No effect if not a government using nomad.

entries.name: add_meritocracy
entries.description: Adds meritocracy to the current scope.

extra.Notes: No effect if not a government using has_meritocracy.

entries.name: set_meritocracy
entries.description: Sets the current meritocracy for the current scope.

extra.Notes: No effect if not a government using has_meritocracy.

entries.name: add_revolutionary_zeal
entries.description: Adds revolutionary zeal to the current scope.

extra.Notes: No effect if not a government using revolutionary zeal.

entries.name: adopt_reform_progress
entries.description: Adopts the government reform progress from the target country scope.

extra.Notes: Used when the Papal States is released.

entries.name: change_statists_vs_orangists
entries.description: Changes the Organist-Statist balance.

extra.Notes: Positive moves towards Orangist, negative moves towards Statists. In percent form.

entries.name: change_statists_vs_monarchists
entries.description: Changes the Monarchist-Statist balance.

extra.Notes: Positive moves towards Monarchist, negative moves towards Statists. In percent form.

entries.name: change_government
entries.description: Changes the government of the current scope.

extra.Notes: Governments are found in {{path|common/governments/*.txt}}.
extra.Version Added: 1.1 (1.28.3 - will now always refund reform progress)

entries.name: set_government_rank
entries.description: Changes the government rank of the current scope.

extra.Notes: Default range is 1 to 3.

entries.name: add_government_power
entries.description: Changes the value of the specified power for the specified government mechanic.

extra.Notes: [[government mechanic modding|Government mechanics]] can be found in common/government_mechanics
extra.Version Added:
1.35
Initially added in 1.23 with a different syntax and for hardcoded government mechanics.

entries.name: add_government_power_scaled_to_seats
entries.description: Changes the value of the specified power for the specified government mechanic scaled to the amount of parliament seats the country has.

extra.Notes: [[government mechanic modding|Government mechanics]] can be found in common/government_mechanics

entries.name: set_government_power
entries.description: Sets the specified power for the specified government mechanic to the specified value.

extra.Notes: [[government mechanic modding|Government mechanics]] can be found in common/government_mechanics

entries.name: freeze_government_power
entries.description: Freezes the specified power of the specified government mechanic, so that it cannot be changed anymore.

extra.Notes: [[government mechanic modding|Government mechanics]] can be found in common/government_mechanics

entries.name: unfreeze_government_power
entries.description: Unfreezes the specified power of the specified government mechanic, so that it can be changed again.

extra.Notes: [[government mechanic modding|Government mechanics]] can be found in common/government_mechanics

entries.name: regenerate_government_mechanics
entries.description: Regenerates the country's government mechanics.

extra.Notes: Used for UI purposes.

entries.name: set_government_and_rank
entries.description: Changes the current scope's government and rank at the same time.

extra.Notes:
Governments are found in {{path|common/governments/*.txt}}.

Will respect that governments have fixed ranks and the maximum ranks for subject types.

entries.name: set_legacy_government
entries.description: Switches to the given government type.

extra.Notes: No effect if {{icon|dhr}} Dharma is active. Use add_government_reform or change_government_via_reform instead. Combine this with effects that change government only if Dharma is active, e.g. change_government_via_reform.

entries.name: dissolve_parliament
entries.description: Disables the Parliament mechanic.

extra.Notes: Only effects governments with has_parliament.

entries.name: reinstate_parliament
entries.description: Re-enables the Parliament mechanic after dissolve_parliament.

extra.Notes: Only effects governments with has_parliament.

entries.name: start_debate
entries.description: Starts a debate in the parliament for the specified issue.

extra.Notes:
Parliament issues can be found in common/parliament_issues.

Ongoing debates will be canceled (canceling a debate should NOT activate the prestige loss).

entries.name: end_current_debate
entries.description: Ends the current debate immediately. If yes then the debate succeeds and the issue gets enacted. If no then the debate fails and the failure penalty is applied.

entries.name: cancel_current_debate
entries.description: Cancels the current debate in parliament, allowing a new debate to be started.

entries.name: remove_enacted_issue
entries.description: Removes the currently enacted parliament issue, allowing a new debate to be started.

entries.name: enact_issue
entries.description: Enacts the parliament issue and skips the whole process of debating.

extra.Notes: Parliament issues can be found in common/parliament_issues.

entries.name: add_accepted_culture
entries.description: Adds a new accepted culture to the current scope.

extra.Notes:
Cultures are found in {{path|common/cultures/*.txt}}.

Can utilise [[Variables|Event Scope Values]].

entries.name: add_accepted_culture_or_dip_power
entries.description: Adds a new accepted culture to the current scope.

extra.Notes:
In contrast to the standalone effect, this variant requires the culture to be specified by name.
The dip reward will only be granted if the country has zero remaining promoted culture slots. The effect will not grant a dip reward if free = yes is specified.

A culture granted with  free = yes will never take a culture slot and this cannot be reversed. The culture can still be promoted and demoted normally.

Only the last used argument of dip_reward = yes and value =  will be used.

entries.name: change_primary_culture
entries.description: Changes the primary culture of the current scope.

extra.Notes:
Cultures are found in {{path|common/cultures/*.txt}}.

Can utilise [[Variables|Event Scope Values]].

entries.name: remove_accepted_culture
entries.description: Removes an accepted culture from the current scope.

extra.Notes:
Cultures are found in {{path|common/cultures/*.txt}}.

Can utilise [[Variables|Event Scope Values]].

entries.name: change_religion
entries.description: Changes the religion of the current scope.

entries.name: enable_religion
entries.description: Enables an religion that has been restricted with the date parameter.

extra.Notes: Religions are found in {{path|common/religions/*.txt}}

entries.name: force_converted
entries.description: Sets whether the current scope has been force converted.

entries.name: add_authority
entries.description: Adds authority to the current scope. Used in Religious Reforms that use authority.

extra.Notes: No effect if the country does not hold a religion using authority.

entries.name: add_doom
entries.description: Adds doom to the current scope. Used in Religious Reforms that use doom.

extra.Notes: No effect if the country does not hold a religion using doom.

entries.name: remove_religious_reforms
entries.description: Removes taken religious reforms from the current scope.

extra.Notes: No effect if the country does not hold a religion using religious_reforms.

entries.name: add_fervor
entries.description: Adds Fervor to the current scope.

extra.Notes: No effect if the country does not hold a religion using fervor.

entries.name: add_karma
entries.description: Adds Karma to the current scope.

extra.Notes: No effect if the country does not hold a religion using uses_karma.

entries.name: set_karma
entries.description: Sets the Karma value for the current scope.

extra.Notes: No effect if the country does not hold a religion using uses_karma.

entries.name: add_church_power
entries.description: Adds Church Power to the current scope.

extra.Notes: No effect if the country does not hold a religion using uses_church_power.

entries.name: add_church_aspect
entries.description: Adds the defined aspect to the current scope.

extra.Notes:
Church Aspects are found in {{path|common/church_aspects/00_church_aspects.txt}}.

No effect if the country does not hold a religion using uses_church_power and the aspect set in aspects.

Does not work with Blessings.

entries.name: remove_church_aspect
entries.description: Removes the defined aspect from the current scope.

extra.Notes:
|Church Aspects are found in {{path|common/church_aspects/00_church_aspects.txt}}.

No effect if the country does not have the aspect.

Does not work with Blessings.

entries.name: set_defender_of_the_faith
entries.description: Sets the defined scope as the Defender of the Faith of the specified religion.

extra.Notes:
If religion is not defined, uses the current religion of who.

Works even for religions that do not normally allow Defender of the Faith.

entries.name: remove_defender_of_the_faith
entries.description: Removes the defined scope as the Defender of the Faith of the specified religion.

extra.Notes: If religion is not defined, uses the current religion of who.

entries.name: set_papal_controller
entries.description: Sets the defined scope as the new Papal Controller.

extra.Notes: Current Pope will die.

entries.name: transfer_papal_controller
entries.description: Sets the defined scope as the new Papal Controller without killing the current Pope.

entries.name: add_papal_influence
entries.description: Adds Papal Influence to the current scope.

extra.Notes: No effect if the country does not hold a religion using papacy.

entries.name: add_reform_desire
entries.description: Adds Reform Desire to the country's religion.

entries.name: excommunicate
entries.description: Excommunicates the defined scope. If already excommunicated, removes excommunication.

entries.name: set_papacy_active
entries.description: Enables or disables the Papacy mechanic.

entries.name: add_piety
entries.description: Adds Piety to the current scope.

extra.Notes: No effect if the country does not hold a religion using uses_piety.

entries.description: add_curia_treasury = 100

extra.Notes: Adds money to the curia treasury

entries.name: set_school_opinion
entries.description:
Changes the current scope's school opinion towards the defined scope's school.
Changes the current scope's school opinion towards the defined school.

extra.Notes: -1 for negative, 0 for netural and 1 for positive.

entries.name: set_religious_school
entries.description: Changes the current scope's religious school.

extra.Notes: Religious Schools are found in {{path|common/religions/00_religions.txt}}.

entries.name: add_patriarch_authority
entries.description: Adds Patriarch Authority to the current scope.

extra.Notes: No effect if the country does not hold a religion using has_patriarchs.

entries.name: change_personal_deity
entries.description: Changes the current personal deity for the current scope.

extra.Notes:
Personal Deities are found in {{path|common/personal_deities/*.txt}}.

No effect if the country does not hold a religion using personal_deity.

entries.name: add_harmony
entries.description: Adds Harmony to the current scope.

extra.Notes: No effect if the country does not hold a religion using uses_harmony.

entries.name: add_harmonized_religion
entries.description: Adds a religion to the list of Harmonized religions for the current scope.

extra.Notes: No effect if the country does not hold a religion using uses_harmony.

entries.name: add_harmonization_progress
entries.description: Adds Harmonization Progress for the current harmonization target to the current scope.

extra.Notes: No effect if the country does not hold a religion using uses_harmony.

entries.name: unlock_cult
entries.description: Adds the defined cult to the current scope.

extra.Notes:
Cults can be found in {{path|common/fetishist_cults/*.txt}}.

No effect if the country does not hold a religion using fetishist_cult.

entries.name: change_cult
entries.description: Changes the current cult for the current scope.

extra.Notes:
Cults can be found in {{path|common/fetishist_cults/*.txt}}.

No effect if the country does not hold a religion using fetishist_cult.

entries.name: add_isolationism
entries.description: Adds Isolationism to the current scope.

extra.Notes: No effect if the country does not hold a religion using uses_isolationism.

entries.name: set_isolationism
entries.description: Sets Isolationism for the current scope.

extra.Notes:
Do not use. Not used in vanilla EU4, and appears to set the isolationism to the lowest value, regardless of the number used.
No effect if the country does not hold a religion using uses_isolationism.

entries.name: add_incident_variable_value
entries.description: Changes the value of an Incident for the current scope.

extra.Notes:
Incidents are found in {{path|common/isolationism/*.txt}}

No effect if the country does not hold a religion using uses_isolationism.

entries.name: set_incident_variable_value
entries.description: Sets the value of an Incident for the current scope.

extra.Notes:
Incidents are found in {{path|common/isolationism/*.txt}}

No effect if the country does not hold a religion using uses_isolationism.

entries.name: add_idea
entries.description: Adds an idea for the current scope.

extra.Notes:
Ideas are found in {{path|common/ideas/*.txt}}.

Won't work if the idea isn't present in a National Idea set or a taken Ideagroups set for the country.

entries.name: add_idea_group
entries.description: Adds an ideagroup for the current scope.

extra.Notes:
Ideagroups are found in {{path|common/ideas/*.txt}}.

Won't work if the country doesn't have any free ideagroup slots.

entries.name: add_active_policy
entries.description: Adds a policy for the current scope.

extra.Notes:
Policies are found in {{path|common/policies/*.txt}}.

Won't work if the policy triggers are not met by the country, or there are no free policy slots.

entries.name: change_technology_group
entries.description: Changes the technology group of the current scope.

extra.Notes:
Technology Groups are found in {{path|common/technology.txt}}.

Doesn't change units, use change_unit_type.

entries.name: remove_idea
entries.description: Removes an idea for the current scope.

extra.Notes:
Ideas are found in {{path|common/ideas/*.txt}}.

Won't work if the idea isn't held.

entries.name: remove_idea_group
entries.description: Removes an ideagroup for the current scope.

extra.Notes:
Ideagroups are found in {{path|common/ideas/*.txt}}.

Won't work if the ideagroup isn't held.

entries.name: set_primitive
entries.description: Toggles Primitive status for the current scope.

extra.Notes: Primitive status controls whether a country has ships and if they can see Primitive-only mechanics, such as Religious Reforms.

entries.name: swap_free_idea_group
entries.description: Re-evaluates the current scope's national idea set assignment, if they match a different set, they will switch to it.

extra.Notes: Used after tag changes to change Nationa Idea sets.

entries.name: add_next_institution_embracement
entries.description: Adds embracement for the current progressing institution within the current scope.

extra.Notes: Institutions are found in {{path|common/institutions/*.txt}}.

entries.name: add_next_institution_embracement_scaled
entries.description: Adds embracement for the current progressing institution within the current scope, scaled to province development.

extra.Notes: Institutions are found in {{path|common/institutions/*.txt}}.

entries.name: add_adm_tech
entries.description: Adds ADM technologies to the current scope.

extra.Notes: You cannot remove technologies.

entries.name: add_dip_tech
entries.description: Adds DIP technologies to the current scope.

extra.Notes: You cannot remove technologies.

entries.name: add_mil_tech
entries.description: Adds MIL technologies to the current scope.

extra.Notes: You cannot remove technologies.

entries.name: add_prestige
entries.description: Adds prestige to the current scope.

entries.name: set_capital
entries.description: Changes the capital of the scoped country to the selected province ID.

extra.Notes: Can also use the scripted effect move_capital_effect = yes in a province scope nested in a country scope to accomplish the same thing as well as remove province form HRE.

entries.name: add_corruption
entries.description: Adds corruption to the current scope.

entries.name: add_splendor
entries.description: Adds splendor to the current scope.

extra.Notes: Splendor is used to purchase Age abilities.

entries.name: create_advisor
entries.description: Adds the defined advisor to the current scope.

extra.Notes: Defaults the advisor's location to the capital, and religion and culture to the current scope's.

entries.name: kill_advisor
entries.description: Kills a hired advisor for the current scope.

entries.name: remove_advisor
entries.description: Removes a hired advisor for the current scope.

entries.name: remove_advisor_by_category
entries.description: Removes a hired advisor of a monarch power type for the current scope.

extra.Notes: Only works for advisors that have been hired.

entries.name: define_advisor
entries.description: Adds the defined advisor to the current scope.

entries.name: hire_advisor
entries.description: Forcefully hires an advisor, putting it into the court of the current scope. The old advisor gets fired if the space is preoccupied already.

extra.Notes:
Advisor types are found in {{path|common/advisortypes/*.txt}}

Can utilise [[Variables|Event Scope Values]] for the culture and religion parameters.
The name parameter can accept a saved name variable, see set_saved_name for more context.

From a scripting point of view, this effect works exactly like define_advisor with all the same parameters.

entries.name: extend_regency
entries.description: Extends an ongoing regency for the current country scope by the specified amount in years.

entries.name: regency
entries.description: Extends an ongoing regency for the current country scope by the specified amount in years.

entries.name: change_national_focus
entries.description: Changes the national focus of the current country scope.

entries.name: add_power_projection
entries.description: Adds the amount of power projection to the current scope.

entries.name: remove_power_projection
entries.description: Removes the amount of power projection from the current scope.

extra.Notes: If amount is not defined, the entire amount of the specified key is removed instead.

entries.name: add_stability
entries.description: Adds stability to the current scope.

entries.name: add_war_exhaustion
entries.description: Adds war exhaustion to the current scope.

entries.name: add_liberty_desire
entries.description: Adds liberty desire to the current scope.

extra.Notes: Used on the subject to raise liberty desire for the overlord.

entries.name: disband_rebels
entries.description: Disbands all active rebels of the specified type in the provinces of the current scope.

extra.Notes: Rebel types are found in {{path|common/rebel_types/*.txt}}

entries.name: collapse_nation
entries.description: Gives a percentage of the current scope's owned provinces to random native countries.

entries.name: add_disaster_modifier
entries.description: Applies an event modifier to the current scope that is removed when the disaster is over, or the duration runs out.

extra.Notes: Disasters are found in {{path|common/disasters/*.txt}}

entries.name: add_disaster_progress
entries.description: Adds progress towards an already declared (conditions for disaster are met since at least a month) disaster

extra.Notes: Disasters are found in {{path|common/disasters/*.txt}}

entries.name: end_disaster
entries.description: Immediately ends an active disaster for the current scope.

extra.Notes: Disasters are found in {{path|common/disasters/*.txt}}

entries.name: add_rebel_progress
entries.description: Adds progress to a specified rebel type spawning in the current country.

extra.Notes: If no rebel type is defined then progress is added to all rebels.

entries.name: add_army_tradition
entries.description: Adds Army Tradition to the current scope.

entries.name: add_navy_tradition
entries.description: Adds Navy Tradition to the current scope.

entries.name: add_army_professionalism
entries.description: Adds Army Professionalism to the current scope.

extra.Notes: 1 is equal to 100% army professionalism.

entries.name: set_army_professionalism
entries.description: Sets the Army Professionalism value for the current scope.

extra.Notes: 1 is equal to 100% army professionalism.

entries.name: add_manpower
entries.description: Adds manpower to the current scope.

extra.Notes: 1 is equal to 1000 manpower.

entries.name: add_sailors
entries.description: Adds sailors to the current scope.

extra.Notes: 1 is equal to 1 sailor.

entries.name: add_yearly_manpower
entries.description: Adds manpower to the current scope, as a percentage of total yearly manpower.

extra.Notes: 1 is equal to 100% of total yearly manpower.

entries.name: add_yearly_sailors
entries.description: Adds sailors to the current scope, as a percentage of total yearly sailors.

extra.Notes: 1 is equal to 100% of total yearly sailors.

entries.name: create_admiral
entries.description: Generates an new admiral for the current scope.

extra.Notes: changed with 1.1

entries.name: create_explorer
entries.description: Generates an new explorer for the current scope.

extra.Notes: Accepts the same arguments as create_admiral.

entries.name: create_conquistador
entries.description: Generates an new conquistador for the current scope.

extra.Notes: Accepts the same arguments as create_general.

entries.name: create_general
entries.description: Generates an new general for the current scope.

extra.Notes: changed with 1.26

entries.name: change_unit_type
entries.description: Change the unit type for the current scope.

extra.Notes: The unit types correspond to the technology groups found in {{path|common/technology.txt}}.

entries.name: kill_leader
entries.description: Kills a leader held by the current scope matching the type used.

extra.Notes:
Possible types:
* general
* admiral
* conquistador
* explorer
* random
*

entries.name: define_admiral
entries.description: Creates an admiral with the defined attributes for the current scope.

extra.Notes:
Leader traits can be found in {{path|common/leader_personalities/*.txt}}.

Siege improves Blockade Efficiency for admirals.

The name parameter can accept a saved name variable, see set_saved_name for more context.

entries.name: define_explorer
entries.description: Creates an explorer with the defined attributes for the current scope.

extra.Notes:
Leader traits can be found in {{path|common/leader_personalities/*.txt}}.

Siege improves Blockade Efficiency for explorers.

The name parameter can accept a saved name variable, see set_saved_name for more context.

entries.name: define_conquistador
entries.description: Creates a conquistador with the defined attributes for the current scope.

extra.Notes:
Leader traits can be found in {{path|common/leader_personalities/*.txt}}.

The name parameter can accept a saved name variable, see set_saved_name for more context.

entries.name: define_general
entries.description: Creates a general with the defined attributes for the current scope.

extra.Notes:
Leader traits can be found in {{path|common/leader_personalities/*.txt}}.

The name parameter can accept a saved name variable, see set_saved_name for more context.

entries.name: add_company_manpower
entries.description: Changes the defined Mercenary Company's manpower by x percent.

extra.Notes: Only works within Mercenary Company scopes.

entries.name: disband_mercenary_company
entries.description: Disbands the scoped Mercenary Company.

entries.name: convert_leader_to_general
entries.description: The leader of the scoped Mercenary company becomes a general of the previous scope.

extra.Notes: Only works within Mercenary Company scopes.

entries.name: kill_mercenary_leader
entries.description: Kills the leader of the scoped Mercenary company.

extra.Notes: Only works within Mercenary Company scopes.

entries.name: disband_all_units
entries.description: the current country scope disbands all units it has. No matter where they are. Units, which are in battle while this effect fires are "stack wiped".

extra.Notes: Applies to both land and naval units.

entries.name: disband_all_regiments
entries.description: the current country scope disbands all troops it has. No matter where they are. Units, which are in battle while this effect fires are "stack wiped".

extra.Notes: Applies only to land units.

entries.name: disband_all_ships
entries.description: the current country scope disbands all ships it has. No matter where they are. Units, which are in battle while this effect fires are "stack wiped".

entries.name: create_unit_forcelimit_percentage
entries.description: Builds the defined units as a percentage of the owner's forcelimit in capital of the current country scope.

extra.Notes:
Possible types:

* infantry
* cavalry
* artillery
* heavy_ship
* light_ship
* galley
* transport
Special Units:
* janissaries
* cawa
* musketeer
* banner
* cossacks
* streltsy
* rajput
* marines
* hussars
* carolean
* mercenary
* revolutionary_guard
* tercio
* samurai
* man_of_war
* galleon
* caravel
* voc_indiamen
* geobukseon
* galleass
* mamluks
* qizilbash

entries.name: set_naval_doctrine
entries.description: Sets the country's naval doctrine to the specified type.

entries.name: add_historical_friend
entries.description: Makes the defined scope a historical friend of the current scope.

entries.name: add_historical_rival
entries.description: Makes the defined scope a historical rival of the current scope.

entries.name: remove_historical_friend
entries.description: Removes the historical friendship between the defined scope and the current scope.

entries.name: remove_historical_rival
entries.description: Removes the historical rivalry between the defined scope and the current scope.

entries.name: add_rival
entries.description: Makes the defined scope a rival of the current scope.

entries.name: remove_rival
entries.description: Removes the defined scope as a rival of the current scope.

entries.name: force_remove_rival
entries.description: Removes the defined scope as a rival of the current scope. That country cannot be picked as a rival again for the next 15 years.

entries.name: add_trust
entries.description: Adds trust with the defined scope for the current scope.

extra.Notes: Used in conjunction with the Diplomatic Feedback mechanic from The Cossacks DLC.

entries.name: add_favors
entries.description: Adds favors with the defined scope for the current scope.

entries.name: add_opinion
entries.description: Adds an opinion modifier for the current scope held against the defined scope.

extra.Notes: Opinion modifiers are found in {{path|common/opinion_modifiers/*.txt}}

entries.name: reverse_add_opinion
entries.description: Adds an opinion modifier for the defined scope held against the current scope.

extra.Notes: Opinion modifiers are found in {{path|common/opinion_modifiers/*.txt}}

entries.name: remove_opinion
entries.description: Removes an opinion modifier for the current scope held against the defined scope.

extra.Notes: Opinion modifiers are found in {{path|common/opinion_modifiers/*.txt}}

entries.name: reverse_remove_opinion
entries.description: Removes an opinion modifier for the defined scope held against the current scope.

extra.Notes: Opinion modifiers are found in {{path|common/opinion_modifiers/*.txt}}

entries.name: create_alliance
entries.description: Creates an alliance between the current scope and the defined scope.

entries.name: break_alliance
entries.description: Removes an existing alliance between the current scope and the defined scope.

entries.name: create_guarantee
entries.description: Creates a guarantee over the defined scope for the current scope.

entries.name: remove_guarantee
entries.description: Removes guarantee from the defined scope for the current scope.

entries.name: create_marriage
entries.description: Creates a royal marriage between the current scope and the defined scope.

entries.name: force_create_marriage
entries.description: Creates a royal marriage between the current scope and the defined scope.

extra.Notes: Allows the creation of royal marriages between nations and religions disallowing it.

entries.name: create_union
entries.description: Makes the defined scope a junior partner in a personal union with the current scope.

entries.name: create_vassal
entries.description: Creates the defined vassal out of the scopes territory if possible.

extra.Notes:
Uses the vassal subject type.
Target country must not exist. Will be created by this command out of the scopes territory.

entries.name: create_march
entries.description: Makes the defined scope a march subject of the current scope.

extra.Notes:
Uses the march subject type.
Target country must already exist.

entries.name: vassalize
entries.description: Makes the defined scope a vassal subject of the current scope.

extra.Notes:
Uses the vassal subject type.
Target country must already exist.

entries.name: create_subject
entries.description: Makes the defined scope into the defined subject type under the current scope.

extra.Notes: Subject types are found in {{path|common/subject_types/*.txt}}.

entries.name: break_marriage
entries.description: Breaks the current scope's royal marriage with the defined scope.

entries.name: break_union
entries.description: Breaks the current scope's union with the defined scope.

entries.name: inherit
entries.description: The current scope inherits all of the defined scope's provinces.

entries.name: release
entries.description: The current scope releases all provinces with the defined scope's cores.

extra.Notes: Target country must not exist. Unlike 'create_vassal' the released country will not be a vassal.

entries.name: release_all_subjects
entries.description: The current scope grants independence to all their subjects.

entries.name: release_all_possible_countries
entries.description: The current scope releases all countries which can be released from its owned provinces.

extra.Notes: If possible, the order should go from the smallest releasable to the largest. If that is not possible then it should be just random.

entries.name: grant_independence
entries.description: The current scope is granted independence from their overlord.

entries.name: free_vassal
entries.description: Frees a vassal from the current scope.

entries.name: declare_war
entries.description: Creates a no casus belli war against the defined scope for the current scope.

entries.name: declare_war_with_cb
entries.description: Declares war for the current scope against the defined scope, using the defined casus belli.

extra.Notes:
war_goal_provinceis has to be specified if the CB has a wargoal of the following types: take_province, take_core, take_border or take_colony(all which allow the player to select a province as the wargoal when declaring the war). The province has to be a valid province for the CB.

Casus belli are found in {{path|common/cb_types/*.txt}}

entries.name: add_truce_with
entries.description: Creates a truce between the defined scope and the current scope.

extra.Notes: The truce length is the default white peace truce length.

entries.name: white_peace
entries.description: Forces the defined scope into a white peace truce with the current scope.

entries.name: form_coalition_against
entries.description: The current scope creates or joins a coalition against the defined scope.

entries.name: add_casus_belli
entries.description: Adds a casus belli for the current scope against the defined scope.

extra.Notes: Casus belli are found in {{path|common/cb_types/*.txt}}

entries.name: reverse_add_casus_belli
entries.description: Adds a casus belli against the current scope for the defined scope.

extra.Notes: Casus belli are found in {{path|common/cb_types/*.txt}}

entries.name: remove_casus_belli
entries.description: Removes a casus belli held against the defined scope for the current scope.

extra.Notes: Casus belli are found in {{path|common/cb_types/*.txt}}

entries.name: reverse_remove_casus_belli
entries.description: Removes a casus belli held by the defined scope against the current scope.

extra.Notes: Casus belli are found in {{path|common/cb_types/*.txt}}

entries.name: remove_fow
entries.description: Removes the fog of war in the current scope for the ROOT scope (not PREV scope, as previously written).

entries.name: remove_hegemon
entries.description: Removes hegemony status from the current or specified country scope.

extra.Notes: Supports country scope as of 1.35.

entries.name: add_spy_network_from
entries.description: Adds spy network in the current scope for the defined scope.

entries.name: add_spy_network_in
entries.description: Adds spy network for the current scope in the defined scope.

entries.name: join_all_offensive_wars_of
entries.description: Makes the current scope join all offensive wars of the specified scope.

extra.Notes: Fails and throws a script error if the current scope (the tag using this) has a truce with any allies of the defender, even non-co-belligerents.

entries.name: join_all_defensive_wars_of
entries.description: Makes the current scope join all defensive wars of the specified scope.

entries.name: add_aggressive_expansion
entries.description: The current country scope adds X amount of aggressive expansion towards the specified country.

extra.Notes: apply_calcdetermines whether culture & religion modify the value.

entries.name: reverse_add_aggressive_expansion
entries.description: The specified country adds X amount of aggressive expansion towards the current country scope.

extra.Notes: apply_calcdetermines whether culture & religion modify the value.

entries.name: add_subjects_development_ducats
entries.description: The current country scope gains ducats equaling the total development owned by subject countries multiplied by multiplierand age_multiplier.

extra.Notes: triggercontrols which subjects get factored into the total development.

entries.name: add_subjects_development_manpower
entries.description: The current country scope gains manpower equaling 1k times the total development owned by subject countries multiplied by multiplierand age_multiplier.

extra.Notes: triggercontrols which subjects get factored into the total development.

entries.name: create_independent_estate
entries.description: Creates an independent nation from among the current scope's owned provinces.

extra.Notes: The amount of development it gets is based on the estate's land share at the time the effect happens. The specific choice of provinces is governed by the province_independence_weight clause in the estate's file, found in {{path|common/estates/*.txt}}.

entries.name: create_independent_estate_from_religion
entries.description: Creates an independent nation from among the current scope's owned provinces.

extra.Notes: The amount of development it gets is based on the estate's land share at the time the effect happens. The specific choice of provinces is governed by the province_independence_weight clause in the estate's file, found in {{path|common/estates/*.txt}}. It is created with the majority religion of its provinces.

entries.name: add_estate_influence_modifier
entries.description: Adds an influence modifier for the defined estate used by the current scope.

extra.Notes: Estates are found in {{path|common/estates/*.txt}}

entries.name: add_estate_loyalty
entries.description: Adds loyalty for the defined estate used by the current scope.

extra.Notes: Estates are found in {{path|common/estates/*.txt}}

entries.name: add_estate_loyalty_modifier
entries.description: Adds a loyalty equilibrium modifier for the defined estate used by the current scope.

extra.Notes: Estates are found in {{path|common/estates/*.txt}}

entries.name: add_faction
entries.description: Adds a faction to the current scope.

extra.Notes: Factions are found in {{path|common/factions/}}.

entries.name: remove_faction
entries.description: Removes a faction from the current scope.

extra.Notes: Factions are found in {{path|common/factions/}}.

entries.name: add_faction_influence
entries.description: Adds influence for the defined faction.

extra.Notes: Mimics the influence boost from pressing the button in the faction window.

entries.name: set_estate_privilege
entries.description: Adds the specified estate privilege for the current scope.

entries.name: remove_estate_privilege
entries.description: Removes the specified estate privilege for the current scope.

entries.name: set_estate_led_regency_privilege
entries.description: Adds the specified estate privilege for the current regent estate.

extra.Notes: Must be in an estate-led regency.

entries.name: change_estate_land_share
entries.description: Modifies the current land share percentage for the specified estate in the current scope.

entries.name: start_estate_agenda
entries.description: Starts the specified estate agenda.

entries.name: change_adm
entries.description: Adds ADM skill to the current ruler.

entries.name: change_dip
entries.description: Adds DIP skill to the current ruler.

entries.name: change_mil
entries.description: Adds MIL skill to the current ruler.

entries.name: add_ruler_personality
entries.description: Adds the defined personality to the current ruler.

extra.Notes:
Ruler personalities are found in {{path|common/ruler_personalities/00_core.txt}}.
NOTE: Does nothing if the country's religion uses the ancestor mechanic (e.g. Totemist), as this disables the usual ruler personality system.

entries.name: remove_ruler_personality
entries.description: Removes the defined personality from the current ruler.

extra.Notes: Ruler personalities are found in {{path|common/ruler_personalities/00_core.txt}}.

entries.name: clear_scripted_personalities
entries.description: Removes all defined personalities from both the ruler and heir.

entries.name: set_ruler_flag
entries.description: Defines a ruler flag for the current scope's ruler.

extra.Notes: Flags can be appended with scopes or event targets

entries.name: clr_ruler_flag
entries.description: Clears a ruler flag for the current scope's ruler.

entries.name: set_dynasty
entries.description: Sets the dynasty of the current scope's ruler.

extra.Notes: If  is used it must exist in dynasty_names of any culture or culture group.

entries.name: set_ruler_culture
entries.description: Changes the ruler culture of the current scope.

extra.Notes:
Cultures are found in {{path|common/cultures/*.txt}}

Can utilise [[Variables|Event Scope Values]].

entries.name: set_ruler_religion
entries.description: Changes the ruler religion of the current scope.

extra.Notes:
Religions are found in {{path|common/religions/*.txt}}

Can utilise [[Variables|Event Scope Values]].

entries.name: exile_ruler_as
entries.description: Removes the current ruler of the current scope, saving them to the unique string.

entries.name: clear_exiled_ruler
entries.description: Clears a saved exiled ruler.

extra.Notes: Can use this after using the saved exiled ruler in an effect.

entries.name: set_ruler
entries.description: Makes the exiled ruler the ruler of the current scope.

entries.name: kill_ruler
entries.description: Kills the ruler of the current scope.

entries.name: convert_female_ruler_to_general
entries.description: Converts a female ruler into a general.

entries.name: convert_ruler_to_general
entries.description: Converts a male ruler into a general. If an integer is given then it is used as [[army tradition]] during generation.

extra.Notes: Supports integer as army tradition as of 1.34.

entries.name: convert_ruler_to_admiral
entries.description: Converts a male ruler into an admiral. If an integer is given then it is used as [[navy tradition]] during generation.

entries.name: add_ruler_modifier
entries.description: Adds an event modifier to the current scope as a ruler modifier.

extra.Notes: Ruler modifiers are cleared when the ruler dies.

entries.name: define_ruler_to_general
entries.description: Creates a general from the ruler for the current scope.

extra.Notes: Leader traits can be found in {{path|common/leader_personalities/*.txt}}.

entries.name: define_leader_to_ruler
entries.description: Creates a ruler from a leader for the current scope.

entries.name: define_ruler
entries.description: Creates the defined ruler for the current scope.

extra.Notes:
The culture, dynasty and religion attributes can utilise [[Variables|Event Scope Values]].

The name parameter can accept a saved name variable, see set_saved_name for more context.

The leader parameter works like the define_ruler_to_general effect, and accepts the trait argument.

entries.name: define_exiled_ruler
entries.description: Defines a new exiled ruler, saving them to the unique string.

extra.Notes: Works similarly to define_ruler and accepts the same arguments.

entries.name: add_queen_personality
entries.description: Adds the defined personality to the current consort.

extra.Notes: Ruler personalities are found in {{path|common/ruler_personalities/00_core.txt}}

entries.name: remove_queen_personality
entries.description: Removes the defined personality from the current consort.

extra.Notes: Ruler personalities are found in {{path|common/ruler_personalities/00_core.txt}}

entries.name: set_consort_flag
entries.description: Defines a consort flag for the current scope's consort.

extra.Notes: Flags can be appended with scopes or event targets

entries.name: clr_consort_flag
entries.description: Clears a consort flag for the current scope's consort.

entries.name: set_consort_culture
entries.description: Changes the consort culture for the current scope.

extra.Notes:
Cultures are found in {{path|common/cultures/*.txt}}

Can utilise [[Variables|Event Scope Values]].

entries.name: set_consort_religion
entries.description: Changes the consort religion for the current scope.

extra.Notes:
Religions are found in {{path|common/religions/*.txt}}

Can utilise [[Variables|Event Scope Values]].

entries.name: change_consort_regent_to_ruler
entries.description: Makes a consort regent into the current ruler for the current scope.

entries.name: remove_consort
entries.description: Removes the current consort for the current scope.

entries.name: define_consort
entries.description: Creates the defined consort for the current scope.

extra.Notes:
The skill values are not rolled for consorts, meaning the values set are the exact values a consort gets.

The culture and religion attributes can utilise [[Variables|Event Scope Values]].

The name parameter can accept a saved name variable, see set_saved_name for more context.

entries.name: exile_consort_as
entries.description: Removes the current consort of the current scope, saving them to the unique string.

entries.name: set_consort
entries.description: Makes the exiled consort the consort of the current scope.

entries.name: change_heir_adm
entries.description: Adds ADM skill to the current heir.

entries.name: change_heir_dip
entries.description: Adds DIP skill to the current heir.

entries.name: change_heir_mil
entries.description: Adds MIL skill to the current heir.

entries.name: add_heir_personality
entries.description: Adds the defined personality to the current heir.

extra.Notes: Ruler personalities are found in {{path|common/ruler_personalities/00_core.txt}}

entries.name: remove_heir_personality
entries.description: Removes the defined personality from the current heir.

extra.Notes: Ruler personalities are found in {{path|common/ruler_personalities/00_core.txt}}

entries.name: set_heir_flag
entries.description: Defines an heir flag for the current scope's heir.

extra.Notes: Flags can be appended with scopes or event targets

entries.name: clr_heir_flag
entries.description: Clears an heir flag for the current scope's heir.

entries.name: add_heir_claim
entries.description: Adds to the current scope's heir claim.

entries.name: add_heir_support
entries.description: Adds to the local heir's support in an Elective Monarchy.

entries.name: set_heir_culture
entries.description: Changes the heir culture of the current scope.

extra.Notes:
Cultures are found in {{path|common/cultures/*.txt}}

Can utilise [[Variables|Event Scope Values]].

entries.name: set_heir_religion
entries.description: Changes the heir religion of the current scope.

extra.Notes:
Religions are found in {{path|common/religions/*.txt}}

Can utilise [[Variables|Event Scope Values]].

entries.name: exile_heir_as
entries.description: Removes the current heir of the current scope, saving them to the unique string.

entries.name: set_heir
entries.description: Makes the exiled heir the heir of the current scope.

entries.name: kill_heir
entries.description: Kills the heir of the current scope.

extra.Notes: Displays heir death message.

entries.name: remove_heir
entries.description: Removes the heir of the current scope.

extra.Notes: Does not display the heir death message.

entries.name: convert_female_heir_to_general
entries.description: Converts a female heir into a general.

entries.name: convert_heir_to_general
entries.description: Converts a male heir into a general.

entries.name: define_heir_to_general
entries.description: Creates a general from the heir of the current scope.

entries.name: define_heir
entries.description: Creates the defined heir for the current scope.

extra.Notes:
The culture and religion attributes can utilise [[Variables|Event Scope Values]].

The name parameter can accept a saved name variable, see set_saved_name for more context.

entries.name: add_imperial_influence
entries.description: Adds Imperial Influence for the current scope.

extra.Notes: No effect if not emperor.

entries.name: add_scaled_imperial_influence
entries.description: Adds Imperial Influence for the current scope, scaled by the current Imperial Authority value.

extra.Notes: No effect if not emperor.

entries.name: elector
entries.description: Makes the defined scope an elector of the Holy Roman Empire.

entries.name: revoke_reform
entries.description: Removes an Imperial Reform.

extra.Notes: Imperial Reforms are found in {{path|common/imperial_reforms/00_hre.txt}}.

entries.name: set_in_empire
entries.description: Places the current scope and all owned provinces (if valid) in the empire.

entries.name: hre_inheritable
entries.description: Makes the seat of the Emperor inheritable.

entries.name: imperial_ban_allowed
entries.description: Enables the Imperial Ban casus belli.

entries.name: internal_hre_cb
entries.description: Disables casus belli creation for HRE members against one another.

entries.name: set_allow_female_emperor
entries.description: Enables female rulers to become emperor.

entries.name: dismantle_hre
entries.description: Disbands the HRE and removes all members from it.

entries.name: enable_hre_leagues
entries.description: Enables the Religious Leagues.

entries.name: set_hre_religion
entries.description: Makes the defined religion the official religion of the HRE.

entries.name: set_hre_heretic_religion
entries.description: Makes the defined religion the heretic religion of the HRE.

entries.name: set_hre_religion_locked
entries.description: Locks the official and heretic religion assignments, ending the Religious Leagues.

entries.name: set_hre_religion_treaty
entries.description: Ends the Religious Leagues with no set religions.

entries.name: join_league
entries.description: Makes the current scope join the specific League. Does not appear to accept scopes like ROOT.

extra.Notes: League name is case sensitive.

entries.name: leave_league
entries.description: Makes the current scope leave the specific League. Does not appear to accept scopes like ROOT.

extra.Notes: League name is case sensitive.

entries.name: dismantle_empire_of_china
entries.description: Removes the Empire of China and the Mandate system.

entries.name: set_emperor_of_china
entries.description: Sets the current Emperor of China.

entries.name: add_mandate
entries.description: Adds mandate to the current scope.

extra.Notes: No effect if not the emperor of china.

entries.name: set_mandate
entries.description: Sets the mandate value for the current scope.

extra.Notes: No effect if not the emperor of china.

entries.name: set_revolution_target
entries.description: Makes the defined scope the new revolutionary target.

extra.Notes: Use --- to remove the target and not reassign.

entries.name: set_emperor
entries.description: Makes the country scope emperor if yes, or removes the current emperor if no.

extra.Notes:
no will remove the current emperor regardless of scope.
NOTE: No popup for this effect.

entries.name: set_ai_personality
entries.description: Makes the current scope (if AI) the defined personality.

extra.Notes: AI personalities are found in {{path|common/ai_personalities/00_ai_personalities.txt}}.

entries.name: set_ai_attitude
entries.description: Makes the current scope (if AI) have the defined attitude against the defined scope.

extra.Notes: AI attitudes are found in {{path|common/ai_attitudes/00_ai_attitudes.txt}}.

entries.name: province_event
entries.description: Fire a province event for the current province scope. Appears for the owner of the province scope.

extra.Notes: You cannot fire the same event within itself with a delay of 0.

entries.name: add_province_modifier
entries.description: Adds an event modifier to the current province scope as a province modifier.

extra.Notes: Modifiers added with this effect are cleared automatically when the province changes ownership.

entries.name: add_permanent_province_modifier
entries.description: Adds an event modifier to the current province scope as a province modifier.

extra.Notes:
Modifiers added with this effect persist through ownership changes.

entries.name: calc_true_if
entries.description:
Returns true if at least amount number of sub-triggers are true. Triggers can be listed explicitly as individual triggers or selected by an all_ scope (must be an all_ scope to work properly).
Warning: Many triggers return the value they checked instead of true or false. This can lead to unintuitive behaviour.
For example, monthly_adm = 10 will return the amount of monthly admin points instead of true when the value is 10 or greater.
This can be solved by wrapping triggers that should count only once within anOR trigger. All triggers within will only count once. Note that the returned value will pass through an AND trigger, and that may also need to be nested inside an OR.
Accepts the desc =  argument which will append the loc key to the end of the trigger description.
